socialHousingStarts.citation: Taichung City UDD, report on central and city social housing in Taichung (2024-03-08), table 1: central social housing plan 2017-2024, direct-construction allocation, 1st revision (Executive Yuan 2021-01-20)
socialHousingStarts.url: https://www.rdec.taichung.gov.tw/media/1031650/1130308-1-中央與市政府於臺中市境內興建社會住宅執行情形專案報告-都發.pdf
socialHousingStarts.method: Allocation of the city in the central plan (34,000 units over the 8 years 2017-2024) divided by 8; used for 2015-2021, before the 2nd revision. The allocation counts contract awards, not construction starts. No per-year series of starts is published.

rentSubsidyAmount.citation: New Taipei UDD, research report on graded rent subsidies (2019), tables 1, 3 and 5: central amount 5,000; Taipei graded scheme up to 11,000 (4 or more persons, income tier 1)
rentSubsidyAmount.url: https://www.rde.ntpc.gov.tw/userfiles/1160700/files/07新北市住宅租金補貼分級制度評估與分析.pdf
rentSubsidyAmount.method: Largest monthly amount any household could receive: Taipei's own graded scheme (11,000) is above the central amount (5,000). The 2019 table is the only version seen; 2020 and 2021 not verified.

rentSubsidyAmount.citation: New Taipei UDD, application form of the central expanded rent subsidy (amount and multiplier tables); Commercial Times 2025-11-25 (maximum 1.8 x 8,000)
rentSubsidyAmount.method: Base amount of level 1 in Taipei (8,000) times the largest multiplier (1.8, three or more children) = 14,400, from 2022-07; Taipei's top-up fills the gap up to 11,000 only, so it never raises the maximum. 2022 uses this value from the start of the year.

rentSubsidyAmount.citation: New Taipei UDD, research report on graded rent subsidies (2019), tables 1 and 5: central amount 4,000 per household per month for New Taipei
rentSubsidyAmount.url: https://www.rde.ntpc.gov.tw/userfiles/1160700/files/07新北市住宅租金補貼分級制度評估與分析.pdf
rentSubsidyAmount.method: Central flat amount for New Taipei; no city top-up found. Confirmed for 2015-2019; 2020 and 2021 not verified.

rentSubsidyAmount.citation: New Taipei UDD, application form of the central expanded rent subsidy (amount and multiplier tables)
rentSubsidyAmount.method: Base amount of level 1 in the 18 urban districts (5,000) times the largest multiplier (1.8) = 9,000, from 2022-07. 2022 uses this value from the start of the year.
